places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Call promises Wilbarger forty horses by sunup; Newt is finally given a pistol and the outfit saddles up at sundown.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town on the north bank of the Rio Grande, about thirty miles from the Hacienda Flores headquarters

places.name: Hat Creek
places.note: Drunk Dish retches in its sandy bed while Jake and Augustus look on amused and Call arrives to judge him.
places.location_hint: dry creek running between the Dry Bean saloon side of Lonesome Dove and the Hat Creek outfit's house

places.name: Rio Grande
places.note: At dusk the seven-man outfit crosses it heading into Mexico; it was once just a river inside the hacienda's lands.

places.name: Mexico
places.note: The outfit rides into it at nightfall to raid horses.

places.name: Hacienda Flores
places.note: Pedro Flores's huge Coahuila ranch, holding hundreds of horses, many with Texas brands; Call targets it for a hundred-horse raid.
places.location_hint: in Coahuila, Mexico; headquarters about thirty miles from Lonesome Dove, reached by crossing the Rio Grande and riding southeast

places.name: Coahuila
places.note: Mexican state where the Hacienda Flores is the largest ranch; its old lands once spread into Texas.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Wilbarger is surprised to find Latin in this part of Texas; much former hacienda land now lies in it.

places.name: Wilbarger's herd camp
places.note: His three thousand cattle and eleven men wait at a mosquito-plagued spot while he seeks horses.
places.location_hint: beyond the Nueces River from Lonesome Dove, roughly a night's ride away

places.name: Montana
places.note: Call wants extra horses as a remuda for a drive there; Augustus resists the cold.

places.name: Yale College
places.note: Wilbarger claims he studied Latin there; Augustus doubts it.

groups.label: Hat Creek raiding party
groups.hint: just crossed into Mexico at dusk, riding southeast toward the Hacienda Flores about thirty miles off

groups.label: Bolivar
groups.hint: left behind at the Hat Creek house

groups.label: Wilbarger's party
groups.hint: rode off from the Hat Creek house, promising to return at sunup for horses
